import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Gcd

theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : Nat.gcd (2 * n + 1) (n + 1) = 1 := by
  have key_step : Nat.gcd (2 * n + 1) (n + 1) = Nat.gcd (n + 1) 1 :=
    by rw [Nat.gcd_comm, Nat.gcd_sub_right (2 * n + 1) (n + 1) (by simp)]
  have step_two : Nat.gcd (n + 1) 1 = 1 :=
    by rw [Nat.gcd_comm, PNat.one_gcd]
  exact key_step.trans step_two
